files_changed_self_report.rationale: Added per-rule OPA coverage enforcement, hardened OPA formatting checks to per-file execution, and fixed bypass schema resolution to the SCP runtime schema path.
Updated the contributor template/checklist to use prefixed constants, `message` payloads, explicit variant fixture coverage, and clearer local verification commands.
Aligned deny payloads on `message` and added past-due bearer_legacy close-date enforcement with overridable current-time helper.
Required `reason`, rejected non-object waiver entries unconditionally, and added date/date-time validation plus future-expiry enforcement.
Aligned deny payloads on `message` for vendoring-marker findings.
Removed time-sensitive bearer_legacy allow fixture content so the allow fixture remains stable.
Added `reason` and moved expiry far enough into the future for stable allow-fixture behavior.
Converted the deny fixture into a focused missing-`reason` case while keeping the rest of the waiver structurally valid.
Added the missing allow fixture for the `go.mod` manifest variant.
Added the missing deny fixture for the `package.json` manifest variant.
Added the missing deny fixture for the `pyproject.toml` manifest variant.
Added deny-path coverage for flat auth, non-object accepted_modes entries, and past bearer_legacy close dates.
Added scalar-array, mixed-array, invalid-temporal, expired-waiver, and required-`reason` coverage.
Added allow/deny unit coverage for the previously missing manifest variants.
Populated the waiver-file array schema so the break-glass bypass gate can validate the actual waivers.json file shape.

Local Regal lint, OPA tests, per-rule coverage checks, schema validation, and the required verify commands all passed.
